learning_outcomes.text: has knowledge of classical physics necessary to solve engineering problems.
can solve tasks from classical physics and interpret necessary solutions needed for engineering problems.

syllabus_topics: Problem-solving strategies based on equations of motion and interpretation of the derivative
Information about the system based on Newton's laws of motion for translation and rotation
Modeling the dynamics of motion of simple systems
Testing the balance of a mechanical system
Conclusions from the principle of conservation of mechanical energy
Conclusions from the principle of conservation of momentum and angular momentum
Strategies for solving problems of systems moving in harmonic and damped harmonic motion based on equations of motion and derivative interpretation
Information about the thermodynamic system on a micro and macro scale
assessment_rules: The passing threshold for the midterm colloquium is 70.0%.
bibliography: K. Wrzask, Physics problems step by step, Faculty of Mechanical Engineering and Ship Technology, PG
degree: Mechanical Engineering, first-cycle (engineer), specialization Design and Production Engineering
